sn12.37:1.2: nāyaṃ bhikkhave kāyo tumhākaṃ nāpi aññesaṃ.
sn12.37:1.3: purāṇamidaṃ bhikkhave kammaṃ abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ vedanīyaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn12.37:2.1: tatra bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako paṭiccasamuppādaññeva sādhukaṃ yoniso manasikaroti
sn12.37:2.2: iti imasmiṃ sati idaṃ hoti imassup pādāidaṃ uppajjati
sn12.37:2.3: imasmiṃ asati idaṃ na hoti imassa nirodhā idaṃ nirujjhati yadidaṃ
